client/src/pages/Home.tsx.name: Home catalog
client/src/pages/Home.tsx.description: The starting screen where people find the workflows, forms, agents and apps they can use, then start one.

client/src/pages/Home/components/Catalog.name: Catalog filters
client/src/pages/Home/components/Catalog.description: Narrows the home catalog by search term, resource type or collection.

client/src/pages/Home/components/Collect.name: Collection editor
client/src/pages/Home/components/Collect.description: Creates and edits a collection, the named group of items shown on the home catalog.

client/src/pages/Home/components/Collect.name: Collection icon picker
client/src/pages/Home/components/Collect.description: Chooses the icon that marks a collection on the home catalog.

client/src/pages/Home/components/Collect.name: Collection navigation
client/src/pages/Home/components/Collect.description: Shows collections as links that filter the catalog without changing what anyone is allowed to open.

client/src/pages/Home/components/HomeBro.name: Catalog browsing
client/src/pages/Home/components/HomeBro.description: Shows the browsable resources on the home screen, with empty states when nothing matches.

client/src/pages/Home/components/Resourc.name: Resource card
client/src/pages/Home/components/Resourc.description: Shows one workflow, form, agent or app as a card with the action that starts it.

client/src/pages/Home/components/Resourc.name: Resource list view
client/src/pages/Home/components/Resourc.description: Shows the same catalog resources as a compact list instead of cards.

client/src/pages/Home/home-search.css.name: Home search styling
client/src/pages/Home/home-search.css.description: Sets the look of the home screen's search box and the results beneath it.

client/src/pages/Identities.tsx.name: Service identities
client/src/pages/Identities.tsx.description: Shows the accounts that run automated work no person started, per organization and platform-wide.

client/src/pages/IntegrationDetail.tsx.name: Integration detail page
client/src/pages/IntegrationDetail.tsx.description: Shows one integration's connection, settings, field mappings and who it is shared with.

client/src/pages/Integrations.tsx.name: Integrations list
client/src/pages/Integrations.tsx.description: Lists the outside systems the platform works with, such as Microsoft 365, GitHub or a service desk.

client/src/pages/Integrations/Integratio.name: Connection status
client/src/pages/Integrations/Integratio.description: Says whether an integration is connected, needs reconnecting, or failed, and why.

client/src/pages/Integrations/Integratio.name: Integration cards
client/src/pages/Integrations/Integratio.description: Shows the available integrations as cards with their state and a shortcut to manage each.

client/src/pages/Knowledge.tsx.name: Knowledge page
client/src/pages/Knowledge.tsx.description: Manages the documents agents and workflows can draw on, with search, editing and sharing.

client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeDele.name: Delete document prompt
client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeDele.description: Confirms removing a knowledge document and says who will lose access to it.

client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeDocu.name: Knowledge document list
client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeDocu.description: Lists knowledge documents with their titles, who can see them and when they last changed.

client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeEdit.name: Knowledge editor
client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeEdit.description: Holds the writing area for a knowledge document while it is being edited.

client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeFilt.name: Knowledge filters
client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeFilt.description: Narrows the knowledge list by search and sharing, staying in reach on narrow screens.

client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeScop.name: Knowledge sharing dialog
client/src/pages/knowledge/KnowledgeScop.description: Chooses which organizations and roles can use a knowledge document.

client/src/pages/Login.tsx.name: Sign-in page
client/src/pages/Login.tsx.description: Signs people in with a password, an extra verification step, a passkey or their company account.

client/src/pages/mcp/components/Connecti.name: Connection tool catalog
client/src/pages/mcp/components/Connecti.description: Lists the tools an AI connection offers and what each one lets the assistant do.

client/src/pages/mcp/components/NewConne.name: New AI connection dialog
client/src/pages/mcp/components/NewConne.description: Starts a new connection for an AI assistant, choosing the organization and the first sign-in details.

client/src/pages/mcp/components/ServerCo.name: Server connections list
client/src/pages/mcp/components/ServerCo.description: Lists the connections made to one AI assistant server.

client/src/pages/mcp/components/ServerSe.name: Server settings summary
client/src/pages/mcp/components/ServerSe.description: Summarises an AI assistant server's key settings at a glance.

client/src/pages/MCPCallback.tsx.name: AI connection return
client/src/pages/MCPCallback.tsx.description: Finishes connecting an AI assistant after it sends the person back from its own sign-in.

client/src/pages/MCPConnectionEdit.tsx.name: AI connection editor
client/src/pages/MCPConnectionEdit.tsx.description: Edits an AI assistant connection: the tools it may use, the organization it works in and who can use it.

client/src/pages/MCPServerDetail.tsx.name: AI server detail page
client/src/pages/MCPServerDetail.tsx.description: Shows one AI assistant server with its connections, available tools and settings.

client/src/pages/MCPServers.tsx.name: AI servers list
client/src/pages/MCPServers.tsx.description: Lists the AI assistant servers the platform offers, with their connections and actions.

client/src/pages/MFASetup.tsx.name: Extra sign-in setup
client/src/pages/MFASetup.tsx.description: Sets up the additional verification step someone's account needs before it can be used.

client/src/pages/OAuthCallback.tsx.name: Connection return
client/src/pages/OAuthCallback.tsx.description: Finishes signing in to an outside service and saves the connection to it.

client/src/pages/Organizations.tsx.name: Organizations page
client/src/pages/Organizations.tsx.description: Manages the organizations that separate access, along with their members, settings and branding.

client/src/pages/ProductUpdates.tsx.name: Product updates page
client/src/pages/ProductUpdates.tsx.description: Shows what has changed in the platform recently, newest first.

client/src/pages/Register.tsx.name: Invitation sign-up
client/src/pages/Register.tsx.description: Accepts an invitation and creates the account for it, with a password or a passkey.

client/src/pages/ROIReports.tsx.name: Savings report
client/src/pages/ROIReports.tsx.description: Estimates the time and money automation has saved over a chosen period, with a downloadable copy.

client/src/pages/RoleDetail.tsx.name: Role detail page
client/src/pages/RoleDetail.tsx.description: Shows one role's permissions and everywhere it applies, with ways to change both.

client/src/pages/Roles.tsx.name: Roles list
client/src/pages/Roles.tsx.description: Lists the roles that decide what people and automation may do, with where each applies.

client/src/pages/roles/RoleActionsMenu.t.name: Role actions menu
client/src/pages/roles/RoleActionsMenu.t.description: Offers what can be done with a role, such as editing, copying or deleting it.

client/src/pages/run-form-route.tsx.name: Form run route
client/src/pages/run-form-route.tsx.description: Opens a form for someone to fill in, loading it ahead of time so it appears quickly.

client/src/pages/RunForm.tsx.name: Fill in a form
client/src/pages/RunForm.tsx.description: Asks a form's questions, checks the answers and submits them to start the work.
